description: This file defines the 'Article' class within the Opencart admin model for CMS. It manages CRUD operations, descriptions, SEO URLs, layouts, ratings, and store associations for CMS articles. The class extends a system engine model and provides methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving article data, including descriptions and SEO configurations.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Represents CMS articles within the OpenCart admin model, providing methods for managing article data including creation, update, deletion, and retrieval, along with associated descriptions, SEO URLs, store links, and layouts.

methods.name: addArticle
methods.description: Adds a new article with associated data such as description, store links, SEO URLs, and layouts. Returns the new article's ID.

methods.name: editArticle
methods.description: Updates an existing article, including its descriptions, store links, SEO URLs, and layouts.

methods.name: deleteArticle
methods.description: Deletes an article and all its related descriptions, store links, SEO URLs, comments, and layouts.

methods.name: getArticle
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific article by its ID.

methods.name: getArticles
methods.description: Fetches a list of articles based on filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getTotalArticles
methods.description: Returns the total count of articles matching optional filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds or updates the description for an article in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with an article.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes descriptions for all articles in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific article.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Gets all descriptions for articles in a particular language.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates an article with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes all store associations for an article.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Assigns a layout to an article for a specific store.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Removes all layout associations from an article.

methods.name: editRating
methods.description: Updates the rating value of an article.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates an article with a store by inserting a record into the `article_to_store` table with the specified article and store IDs.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes all store associations for a given article by deleting corresponding records from the `article_to_store` table.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves an array of store IDs associated with a specific article by querying the `article_to_store` table.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Assigns a layout to an article for a specific store by inserting into the `article_to_layout` table.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Deletes all layout associations from an article by removing related records from the `article_to_layout` table.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes all layout associations that use a specific layout ID from the `article_to_layout` table.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves an associative array mapping store IDs to layout IDs for a given article.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the count of how many articles are associated with a specific layout ID.

methods.name: editCommentStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled/disabled) of a specific comment in the `article_comment` table.

methods.name: editCommentRating
methods.description: Modifies the rating for a specific comment, updating the `rating` field in the `article_comment` table.

methods.name: deleteComment
methods.description: Deletes a specific comment based on its comment ID.

methods.name: deleteCommentsByArticleId
methods.description: Removes all comments associated with a specific article.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific comment by its ID.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Retrieves a list of comments filtered by various optional criteria, including keyword, article, customer, author, status, and date added.

methods.name: getRatings
methods.description: Fetches aggregated rating data for an article, optionally filtered by comment ID.

methods.name: getTotalComments
methods.description: Returns the total number of comments matching specified filtering criteria.
